_instructions: Use this template to report an error in an existing exercise record. Copy to community/submissions/correction-<exercise-slug>-<field>.json, fill every REQUIRED field, then open a Pull Request.
contributor: REQUIRED: Your GitHub username or display name
exercise_slug: REQUIRED: Slug of the exercise to correct. Example: 'barbell-bench-press'
exercise_id: OPTIONAL: UUID of the exercise if known — helps disambiguate slug conflicts
field_name: REQUIRED: Dot-notation path to the field being corrected. Examples: 'name', 'muscles.primary[0].muscle_slug', 'execution.steps[2]', 'training_parameters.rep_ranges.hypertrophy'
current_value: REQUIRED: The exact current value of the field as it appears in the dataset. Can be a string, number, array, or object.
proposed_value: REQUIRED: The correct value that should replace the current value. Must be the same type as current_value.
reason: REQUIRED: A clear explanation of why the current value is incorrect and why the proposed value is correct. Minimum 20 characters.
severity: REQUIRED: One of: critical | major | minor — 'critical' means the data causes harm or is factually wrong in a way that could mislead training; 'major' means significantly incorrect; 'minor' means a typo or cosmetic issue
sources: REQUIRED: At least one source supporting your correction. Can be a URL, DOI, book title + page, or other citable reference.
notes: OPTIONAL: Any additional context, caveats, or nuance the reviewer should know about.
